The Nashville Predators fell to the Ottawa Senators by a 3-2 final in a shootout on Saturday night at Canadian Tire Centre. The result gives the Preds four out of a possible six points to conclude their three-game trip through eastern Canada.

takeaways.nhl:8481593: Jayden Struble made his Predators debut with 19:12 ice time, recording six hits and two blocked shots in a tight-checking game.
takeaways.nhl:8486189: Vitali Pinchuk collected an assist in his NHL debut, setting up Ross Colton's goal just three shifts into his first game.
takeaways.nhl:8479525: Ross Colton scored his first goal as a Predator, assisted by Vitali Pinchuk in the opening period.
takeaways.nhl:8476539: Jonathan Marchessault scored on the power play in the opening period, extending his season-opening point streak to five games.
takeaways.nhl:8483575: Matt Murray made 18 saves in his first NHL start since January 8, 2024, earning praise from Head Coach Andrew Brunette for excellent play.

stories.headline: Cooley walks in with pet bunny Tito before Flames game
stories.nhlSummary:
Devin Cooley hopped into the Scotiabank Saddledome with an adorable sidekick on Saturday.
The Calgary Flames goalie arrived at the arena with his pet bunny, Tito, in tow to help support the Calgary Humane Society.

stories.headline: Shesterkin out for season for Rangers with lower-body injury
stories.nhlSummary: Igor Shesterkin will be out for the remainder of the season with a lower-body injury, the New York Rangers announced Saturday.

takeaways.nhl:8478048: Igor Shesterkin out for remainder of season with lower-body injury sustained against Washington, ending his fantasy value this year.
